questions.stem_text:
Can countries rely on their domestic law as an excuse to violate their obligations under
international law?

options.A: Domestic law always prevails over international law
options.B: Only customary international law prevails over domestic law
options.C: Obligations under international law prevail over domestic law
options.D: Constitutional obligations always prevail over obligations under international law

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Obligations under international law prevail over domestic law

questions.stem_text: Which statement best describes the nature and function of Kelsen's Grundnorm?

options.A: The ultimate source of a legal system's morality.
options.B: The rule that distinguishes norms from habits of obedience.
options.D: A presupposition that facilitates our understanding of the legal system.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - A presupposition that facilitates our understanding of the legal system.

questions.stem_text: Is piracy under international (jure gentium) law subject to universal jurisdiction?

options.A: Piracy jure gentium is subject to flag State jurisdiction
options.B: Piracy jure gentium is subject to universal jurisdiction
options.C: Piracy jure gentium is subject to port State jurisdiction
options.D: Piracy jure gentium is subject to nationality-based jurisdiction

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Piracy jure gentium is subject to universal jurisdiction

questions.stem_text: Posner denies the autonomy of law on two grounds. Name one of them.

options.A: He denies that law develops independently of social and economic forces.
options.B: He claims that law is economically immoral.
options.C: He rejects a positivist account of law.
options.D: He opposes any sociological analysis of the law.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - He denies that law develops independently of social and economic forces.
